Record Class CardMetadataRegistry.CardMetadata

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
it.polimi.ingsw.am43.client.view.gui.components.CardMetadataRegistry.CardMetadata
Record Components:
id - the card identifier
name - the display name of the card
category - the display category of the card
era - the card era, or 0 when no era is available
detail - the display detail associated with the card
Enclosing class:
CardMetadataRegistry
public static record CardMetadataRegistry.CardMetadata(int id, String name, String category, int era, String detail) extends Record
Immutable display metadata for a card.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
